title: 第5章 回到家中愤怒至极第6章 兄弟齐心其利断金
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
“这？怎么回事？”
林毅双眼圆睁，目瞪口呆。
林骏全力以赴的一击，威力实在是太强了。
他现在依旧头皮发麻，脑门都是撕裂感。
他都已经做好了死亡的准备。
却没想到。
林骏就这样毫无征兆，直勾勾的倒下去。
林毅满脸警惕，小心翼翼朝着林骏倒下去的地方走上去，脸色大变。
林骏双眼圆睁，面目狰狞，最重要的是眉心那道拇指大小的血孔，鲜血还在从里面喷涌而出。
“这……”
咕咚！
林毅忍不住吞了吞口水，赶紧将地上的柴火升起来，照亮整个破旧的庙堂。
“晨儿？”
林毅这才注意到佛像下面，脸色有些苍白，蹲坐在地上的林晨。
他赶紧走上前去，将林晨扶到火边坐下来。
还以为是林晨又偷摸着想要帮助他。
“我刚才不是让你跑么，你回来作甚？”
林毅板着脸，见到林晨的模样，内心也是叹息，故作生气。
但是他哪里会不明白，以林晨的性格，又怎么可能丢下他这个义父独自逃走呢？
“义父，我们这不是没事嘛！”

林晨略微苍白的脸颊，微微笑了笑。
现在身体终究是太弱，根本承受不住施展灵魂攻击的压力。
“真是奇怪。”
林毅略微皱起眉头，将整个破旧的庙堂打量一圈，旋即将目光落在破旧的佛像上。
“我倒是曾经在古籍上看到过，传闻有大能强者，能够凭借意念，千万里隔空杀人，难道这尊佛像是什么大人物的塑像？”
林骏的死亡，他实在是无法解释，只能够想到是身后佛像显灵。
想到这里，他赶紧走上前去，将那尊雕佛像扶正。
“多李前辈救命之恩，我们父子俩回到天元镇，就找几个人来帮前辈把庙重新修缮。”
林毅对着佛像微微鞠躬。
“晨儿，我们赶紧离开这个破庙，重新找个落脚点。”
林毅看着倒在地上已经气绝身亡的林骏，实在是很诡异。
内心有些担忧。
况且林华既然派人前来追杀他们，现在却死在这里，一旦消息传回弘丰城，对方怕是不会善罢甘休。
“嗯。”
林晨也没有犹豫，站起身来，只感觉到天旋地转，差点没有站稳跌倒。
content_en:
"What? What's going on?"
Ji Yi's eyes widened and he was stunned.
Lin Jun's all-out attack was too powerful.
He still has a numb scalp and a tearing feeling on his forehead.
He was already prepared to die.
But I didn't expect it.
Lin Jun just fell down without any warning.
Ji Yi's face was full of vigilance, and he cautiously walked towards the place where Lin Jun fell, his expression changed drastically.
Lin Jun's eyes were wide open and his face was ferocious. The most important thing was the thumb-sized blood hole between his eyebrows, with blood still gushing out from it.
"This..."
Gudong!
Ji Yi couldn't help but swallowed his saliva, and quickly raised the firewood on the ground to illuminate the entire dilapidated temple.
"Chen'er?"
Only then did Lin Yi notice Lin Chen, who was squatting on the ground with a pale face under the Buddha statue.
He quickly walked forward and helped Lin Chen sit down by the fire.
I thought it was Lin Chen who was secretly trying to help him again.
"Didn't I tell you to run away just now? Why did you come back?"
Ji Yi had a straight face, but when he saw Lin Chen's appearance, he sighed and pretended to be angry.
But how could he not understand that with Lin Chen's character, how could he leave his adoptive father and run away alone?
"Father, aren't we fine?"
Lin Chen's slightly pale cheeks smiled slightly.
Now the body is too weak after all and cannot bear the pressure of performing soul attacks.
"It's really weird."
Ji Yi frowned slightly, looked around the entire dilapidated temple, and soon fell on the dilapidated Buddha statue.
"I have seen it in ancient books. It is said that there are powerful people who can kill people thousands of miles away with their thoughts. Is this Buddha a statue of some big shot?"
He really couldn't explain Lin Jun's death. He could only think that it was the appearance of the Buddha statue behind him.
Thinking of this, he quickly stepped forward and straightened the carved Buddha statue.
"Thanks to Senior Li for saving his life, we, father and son, returned to Tianyuan Town and found a few people to help Senior renovate the temple."
Lin Yi bowed slightly to the Buddha statue.
"Chen'er, let's leave this ruined temple quickly and find another place to stay."
Ji Yi looked at Lin Jun, who had fallen to the ground and died, feeling very strange.
There was some worry in my heart.
Moreover, since Lin Hua sent people to hunt them down, but now he is dead here, once the news is spread back to Hongfeng City, the other party may not let it go.
"Yeah."
Lin Chen did not hesitate and stood up. He felt the world was spinning and almost fell down.
